tagline: Two modern apartments, fully yours for the stay
heroNote: Serviced apartments in Dehradun, built for travellers who want space, a kitchen, and a door that locks — not a hotel room.
aboutTitle: Apartments run like a proper stay, not a sublet
aboutBody: Birchwood Residences manages two fully furnished apartment buildings in Dehradun, each set up for guests who are in town for more than a night or two — business trips, longer family visits, or just people who'd rather cook their own breakfast than order it.

Every apartment is cleaned and inspected between guests, comes with high-speed Wi-Fi and a real kitchen, and has a dedicated point of contact on call if anything needs sorting during your stay. No shared hallways with a hundred other listings, no surprises at check-in.
